user.title: Connect a Samsung TV
user.description: Enter the local address of your powered-on TV. Samsung Pointer uses its own connection and does not modify SamsungTV Smart.

pair.title: Authorize the pointer
pair.description: Have the TV remote ready. Press Submit, then allow **{client_name}** on the television. Pairing waits up to 60 seconds. No movement or click commands are sent during setup.

progress.pairing: Allow **{client_name}** on your TV. Waiting for authorization (up to 60 seconds).

error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or hostname, without http:// or a path.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot read TV identity. Turn the TV on and check its local address.

abort.wrong_tv: This address belongs to a different TV. Add it separately.
abort.not_authorized: The TV did not authorize the connection. Check the device connection permissions on the TV and try again.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check TV power, network, and permission to connect.
abort.missing_token: The TV did not provide a reusable pairing token. This model or firmware is not supported by this version.
